'''2006 Yavin IV Regional Reid Smith LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2006 Yavin IV Regional]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2006-04-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35485 V Is For Vindicator]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070923124121/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35485 Internet Archive]</ref>
